title: api/compat: fix erratic CPU stats for one-shot requests
body:
when requesting for a CPU stats when hitting the endpoint `GET /containers/{id}/stats?stream=false&one-shot=true`, for giving the results for CPU usage, it creates a timing bug and therefore gives incorrect results

RootCause : Currently the baseline for the container stats is defined above in the code i.e through `GetContainerStats(nil)`, then It immediately enters the `streamLabel` loop and fetches the stats a second time through GetContainerStats(stats), using the first sample as a baseline.

The time elapsed between it is practically zero milliseconds or sometimes resulting in float point precision errors , and therefore as the CPU usage formula get's incorrectly calculated :
1. cpu_delta = (CPU time used at Point B) - (CPU time used at Point A)
2. system_delta = (Real-world time at Point B) - (Real-world time at Point A)
CPU Percentage = (cpu_delta / system_delta) * 100
